jobs.title: AI Application Engineer (AI FDE)

About CLM AI Chad Love Media AI (CLM AI) is an emerging AI\-powered media and technology venture developing a new generation of digital entertainment, creator experiences and wellbeing technology. Founded by Chad Love, CLM AI's vision is to bring together artificial intelligence, music, film, sport, business, health and beauty within an engaging digital ecosystem designed for Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Our platform aims to combine AI\-powered digital personalities and creator experiences with interactive content, community engagement and emotional wellbeing. Through the development of AI\-powered digital personalities, conversational experiences and personalised digital content, CLM AI aims to explore how artificial intelligence can make entertainment more engaging, accessible and meaningful. **Our mission:** To harness the power of AI and creativity to inspire a new generation. **Our vision:** To build a global AI\-powered media ecosystem that connects entertainment, technology and human potential. **Website:** https://chadlovemedia.com 2\. The Opportunity We are seeking an ambitious, technically strong and entrepreneurial Artificial Intelligence Engineer to join CLM AI as an early member of our founding technology team, working remotely from New York City. This is an opportunity to help shape the AI capabilities of an emerging media and technology platform as it develops from its existing MVP towards a planned commercial launch in 2027\. Working directly with the Founder \& CEO and collaborating with the founding software engineering team, the successful candidate will help design, develop and integrate AI\-powered features across the CLM AI ecosystem. A key area of focus will be the development of intelligent digital personalities and creator experiences, including conversational AI, AI\-assisted content creation, voice technologies and integrations with third\-party generative AI services. The role will involve evaluating AI models and frameworks, building prototypes, developing reliable AI pipelines and translating promising technologies into practical product features. We are looking for someone who combines strong machine learning and AI engineering fundamentals with product thinking, commercial awareness and a genuine interest in the future of generative AI. As an early technical hire, you will have the opportunity to influence CLM AI's AI architecture, technical standards and product roadmap from the outset. 3\. Key ResponsibilitiesAI Engineering \& Product Development * Design, develop and integrate AI capabilities into CLM AI's web applications and digital experiences. * Translate product concepts and business objectives into practical AI engineering solutions. * Research, evaluate and implement suitable AI models, frameworks, APIs and supporting technologies. * Develop prototypes and proof\-of\-concept implementations to assess technical feasibility and commercial value. * Improve the reliability, performance and usability of existing AI\-enabled product features. * Work with the Founder \& CEO and Software Engineer to prioritise and deliver the AI product roadmap. * Help establish the technical foundations required for a commercially viable AI\-powered platform. Digital Personalities \& Creator AI * Help develop AI\-powered digital personalities and interactive creator experiences for the CLM AI platform. * Explore approaches to creating consistent character identities, conversational styles and personality traits. * Integrate suitable voice, avatar and multimedia technologies into interactive digital experiences. * Investigate methods for combining text, voice and visual AI capabilities into cohesive user journeys. * Support the deve valuating what works, challenging assumptions constructively and turning promising ideas into practical applications. We value engineers who can distinguish between impressive demonstrations and reliable product capabilities. You should understand that successful AI engineering involves not only selecting models, but also testing outputs, managing costs, designing safeguards and integrating solutions into usable software. Experience in a large technology company is not essential. Demonstrable ability, sound technical judgement, initiative and a willingness to take ownership are more important than an impressive job title. Experience in creator technology, voice AI, digital personalities or generative media would be particularly valuable, but a strong applied AI foundation and the ability to learn quickly are essential. 9\. Location \& Working Arrangements * Remote\-first position based in New York City, USA. * Work primarily from your home office or another suitable remote workspace. * Collaborate with an internationally minded founding team and external technology partners. * Report directly to the Founder \& CEO and work closely with the Founding Software Engineer. * Participate in agreed planning meetings, progress reviews and technical demonstrations. * Maintain clear communication regarding deliverables, risks, dependencies and progress. * Coordinate across relevant US and UK working hours where reasonably required. You'll have real influence over both the product and the brand as we grow. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design features and flows across our HELOC application, from early problem definition through production ready designs * Conduct user research, including customer interviews and usability testing * Review session recordings, funnel data, and customer feedback from support, reviews, and calls to understand where customers get stuck * Design for our website, landing pages, and paid ads across Meta, Google, and TikTok, keeping the brand consistent from the first ad to the card in the mailbox * Keep the brand consistent from the first ad a customer sees to the card in their mailbox * Build a deep understanding of our customers and home equity products * Present your work and explain your design decisions clearly, backed by data or sound reasoning * Contribute to our design system and design culture by sharing work early and giving and receiving feedback * Bring AI tools and agentic workflows (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar) into your process to prototype quickly and iterate in short loops **What you’ll need** -------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in product design, brand design, or both * A portfolio that shows shipped product work, ideally alongside some brand or marketing design * Strong product instincts. You think about the whole customer experience and help shape what gets built rather than executing a spec handed to you * Experience conducting user research and turning customer insights into design changes * Experience using data and experiment results to shape design decisions * Experience designing complete user flows, not just individual screens * Strong Figma skills, including clean, organized files and components * Solid foundations in typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and interaction design * You've integrated AI agents into how you design and build, and you can speak to what that changed * Clear communication and comfort presenting to engineers, product, and leadership * The ability to manage several projects at once without letting quality slip **You are a Good Fit if** ------------------------- * You are product driven. You care about the user experience. * You have experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated industry. * You have an operator and builder mindset. You spot opportunities early, have the creative instinct to know what will resonate, and the drive to jump in and ship it. * You've shipped your own designs to production using Claude Code or similar tool **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * **Compensation:** Base Salary: $130,000 \- $160,000 \+ Equity. * **Market Opportunity:** Join a team tackling the $30T home equity market. * **Early Impact:** Help shape our operations from the ground up. * **Ownership**: Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and room to grow. * **Location**: On\-site, New York City. * **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employer paid premiums on select plans, Flexible time off, 10 company holidays, free lunch in office every Friday, 401(k) account, FSA, commuter benefits. Compensation Range: $130K \- $160K

jobs.title: Product Specialist
jobs.description: ### **About Actively AI** Actively AI is defining a new category: Intelligence\-Led Revenue. Revenue organizations have always been bottlenecked on human capacity. Reps triage which accounts get attention. Context disappears at every handoff. On any given day, the vast majority of accounts have exactly zero people thinking about them. Actively addresses this at the structural level. Our platform deploys Per\-Account AgentsTM across our customers’ TAM, working 24/7 to research, identify opportunities, and advance next steps without being asked. Leading enterprises including Ramp, Ironclad, and Samsara are already making this shift. Our co\-founders are former Stanford AI researchers, and the team comes from Harvard, CMU, Berkeley, Brex, Scale AI, and Google. We've raised $68M from TCV, First Harmonic, Bain Capital Ventures, First Round Capital, and more. ### **About the Role** As a **Product Specialist**, you’ll become one of the deepest experts in how Actively works – and help our customers become experts too. You’ll sit at the intersection of **product mastery and customer enablement**. You’ll learn Actively deeply – how our agents behave, how different configurations change outcomes, what makes a workflow click, and where users get stuck – and then translate that knowledge into exceptional experiences for our customers. You’ll spend your time teaching users, experimenting with the product, configuring workflows, answering hard product questions, and helping customers discover the moments where an AI\-native way of working suddenly clicks. We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about AI products, loves teaching people, and gets energy from tinkering, testing, and figuring out how to make the product work better for users. One moment, you might be leading an onboarding for a team of Account Executives. The next, you might be experimenting with an agent configuration, figuring out why a workflow isn’t producing the expected result, reproducing a bug, or helping a rep discover a better way to use Actively in their day\-to\-day work. Because you’ll see the product through users’ eyes every day, you’ll also be the most vital feedback loop into Product and Engineering – identifying recurring friction, emerging use cases, and opportunities to make Actively dramatically easier and more powerful. This is a unique opportunity to become an expert in an emerging category of software. Agentic products are still new: the best ways to configure them, teach them, and integrate them into how people work are being invented right now. You’ll help figure that out alongside our customers. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Become one of Actively’s deepest product experts.** Learn the ins and outs of our agents, workflows, configurations, and product surfaces – and build intuition for what makes users successful. * **Teach users how to win with the product.** Lead onboarding, enablement, and hands\-on working sessions that help users understand not just *how* Actively works, but how to incorporate it into the way they sell. * **Experiment, configure, and optimize.** Tinker with agents, prompts, templates, and workflows to understand what works, improve the user experience, and apply proven patterns across customers. * **Be the first line of product diagnosis.** When something behaves unexpectedly, investigate why – is it configuration, user behavior, data, or a product issue? Solve what you can and escalate when you uncover deeper engineering work is needed. * **Turn customer interactions into product insight.** Identify recurring friction, emerging use cases, and patterns in how users interact with Actively, and bring those learnings directly back to Product and Engineering. * **Make what works repeatable.** Turn recurring questions and successful approaches into guides, onboarding materials, and repeatable playbooks. * **Help bring new capabilities to life.** Learn new features deeply, figure out the best way to use them in practice, and help customers adopt them quickly. ### **Who You Are** * You are **extremely customer\-obsessed**. You genuinely like sitting with a user, understanding what isn’t working, and staying with the problem until they’re successful. * You are an **exceptional communicator and teacher**. You can make something complex feel simple, whether live on a call or in a 90\-second Loom. * You **love seeing users “get it.”** You get genuine satisfaction from teaching someone something new, watching them have an aha moment, and helping them become more confident and effective with the product. * You are a **product nerd**. You love learning how products really work, testing different ways of using them, and developing intuition for what creates a great user experience. When something behaves unexpectedly, you want to understand why. * You’re excited by **AI\-native products** and want to understand how agents work in practice – their capabilities, limitations, configurations, and edge cases. * You have enough **technical fluency** to be dangerous. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you’re comfortable with systems, data, configuration, debugging, and learning new technical tools. * You **thrive in an early\-stage environment** where the playbook is still being written. You notice repeated patterns and naturally think, *“How do we make this easier the next hundred times?”* ### **Backgrounds That Could Be a Great Fit** We care more about the shape of your experience than your exact title. You may have 4\-5\+ years of: * Solutions Engineering / Solutions Consulting * Technical implementation or onboarding * Customer enablement with deep product ownership * Technical Customer Success * Product operations in a complex SaaS product * Sales or GTM, if you were the highly technical, product\-obsessed person on the team and want to move closer to product Experience selling to or working within modern GTM teams is a plus. *Actively AI provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Actively AI factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. Additionally, Actively AI leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Actively.ai reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.* *Actively AI is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Actively AI is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.* Compensation Range: $130,000 \- $180,000 USD ### **Why Join** At Actively, you write playbooks rather than follow them. You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see directly how your work changes what customers can do — across a product and go\-to\-market motion that is scaling fast. The team is high\-caliber and low\-ego: people who work from first principles, move with urgency, and care deeply about building something that drives real value. If that's the kind of challenge you're looking for, Actively is the right place. ### **Benefits** * Competitive Early\-Stage Equity * + Health, Dental, Vision Coverage * Unlimited PTO \+ Recharge Days * ️ Catered Lunch on Tuesday \& Friday, Dinners every day! * Fully Stocked Kitchen * Cutting\-Edge Tech \& Tools * Annual Off\-sites \& Monthly Events * Commuter Benefits * Cozy Office in NYC

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer / Applied Research Scientist — Embodied AI
jobs.description: **Robotics Engineer / Applied Research Scientist — Embodied AI** Artly AI \| Seattle, WA \| Full\-time \| In person Artly AI is building intelligent robots that learn, adapt, and perform complex real\-world tasks. We are looking for a Robotics Engineer / Applied Research Scientist to develop robot control systems, data pipelines, and state\-of\-the\-art action policies—and bring them to physical robots. **Responsibilities** * Develop robot control drivers, APIs, and low\-level infrastructure for robotic arms, dexterous hands, sensors, and cameras. * Build scalable data acquisition and demonstration pipelines spanning teleoperation, multimodal sensing, data processing, and dataset management. * Research and develop learned robot policies, including vision\-language\-action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and world action models (WAMs); apply imitation learning and reinforcement learning to policy training. * Train, evaluate, and deploy learned policies for complex manipulation and real\-world tasks. * Translate robotics and AI research into reliable systems for commercial environments. **Qualifications** * Strong background in robotics, machine learning, computer vision, or control. * Experience with Python/C\+\+, ROS/ROS2, robot control, or manipulation systems. * Hands\-on experience with PyTorch or comparable deep\-learning frameworks. * Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, or robotics foundation models is highly desirable. * MS/PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience. **Compensation and benefits** * Annual base salary: $110,000–$170,000\. * Stock options. * 20 paid vacation days per year. * 10 paid holidays per year. * Separate paid sick leave. * Medical, dental, and vision coverage. This is a full\-time, in\-person position in Seattle, Washington. Learn more about Artly AI: https://artly.ai Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Stock options * Vision insurance People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** At Watney, Senior Manufacturing Engineers turn robotic automation concepts into production\-ready manufacturing systems. This is a hands\-on, fast\-moving engineering role focused on automating the assembly of data center racks and related hardware. You will be expected to move quickly from customer requirements and early concepts to working prototypes and production\-ready solutions. You will design fixtures, tooling, mechatronic equipment, and manufacturing processes; develop automation concepts; and work directly with customers to turn urgent manufacturing needs into practical solutions. **What You'll Do** * Design fixtures, tooling, mechanisms, and mechatronic equipment to enable robotic assembly of data center racks and related hardware. * Develop innovative concepts to automate manufacturing and assembly processes, moving rapidly from concept and prototype through production deployment. * Make sound engineering tradeoffs and deliver working hardware against aggressive customer and production schedules. * Develop automated processes and equipment for fiber\-optic cable assembly, routing, handling, and cable management. * Design mechanical components and assemblies including machined, sheet metal, plastic, and 3D printed parts. * Develop manufacturing processes, production flows, and work instructions for new and automated production lines. * Work closely with robotics, controls, electrical, and software engineers to integrate mechanical equipment into complete robotic systems. * Work directly with customers to understand their products and manufacturing challenges and translate requirements into actionable engineering solutions. * Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, robotics, and manufacturing issues during development and production ramp. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. * Experience designing and launching high\-volume hardware products and manufacturing processes. * Strong hands\-on mechanical design experience with production hardware, tooling, fixtures, or automation equipment. * Experience working with manufacturing teams to take designs from prototype through production ramp. **You May Be A Good Fit If You** * Are a hands\-on mechanical or mechatronics engineer who likes to design, build, test, and debug hardware. * Understand how data center racks, servers, cable systems, and related hardware are designed and assembled. * Have strong mechanical design skills and experience with mechanisms, motors, actuators, sensors, plastics, machined parts, sheet metal, and cable management. * Understand robotic systems and design for automation, including fixtures, tooling, end effectors, and the practical requirements for reliable robotic assembly. * Can look at a manual manufacturing operation and develop creative, practical ways to automate it. * Have experience taking manufacturing equipment or processes from concept through production deployment. * Thrive in a startup environment where priorities move quickly, schedules are aggressive, and engineers are expected to take ownership and get hardware working. * Can communicate directly with customers and turn loosely defined manufacturing problems into working hardware and production processes. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **About Atom Security** Atom Security LLC is a specialized cybersecurity brand purpose\-built on the foundation of Proven IT, a trusted managed services provider with a proven track record of delivering technology solutions to clients across the Midwest. Built to extend Proven IT’s continued success into a dedicated security practice, Atom Security delivers exceptional Managed Security Services (MSSP), professional security consulting, and fractional Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) services to organizations that require specialized expertise beyond the scope of a generalist technology provider. Atom Security’s launch focus is the Defense Industrial Base (DIB), serving defense contractors pursuing CMMC Level 2 certification through a purpose\-built Microsoft GCC High sovereign platform. In parallel, Atom’s commercial practice serves clients in regulated industries including healthcare, finance, and manufacturing. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to help build and define a specialized security brand from inception, with direct impact on the architecture, culture, and client experience of a growing practice. **About This Role** This role owns end\-to\-end engineering delivery of Atom Security’s GCC High and Azure Commercial operations infrastructure — from tenant provisioning through security toolchain deployment and legacy tool migration — against an active, near\-term go\-live target. The platform supports a dual\-track service model: a Microsoft GCC High sovereign track for CMMC\-scoped DIB clients, and an Azure Commercial track for the broader managed security practice. This is a build role with a clear growth trajectory. The initial phase is a structured engineering sprint with defined deliverables and milestones. As the platform becomes operational and Atom Security scales, this position is designed to flex based on organizational needs and individual strengths — evolving toward either deep infrastructure ownership and ongoing platform administration, or toward client\-facing technical roles including vCISO support, client onboarding, and technical advisory engagements with DIB and commercial clients. The right candidate will have both the technical depth to build the platform and the professional presence to engage with clients as the practice grows. Candidates must have hands\-on experience provisioning and administering Microsoft GCC High environments. Azure Commercial experience alone is insufficient — the build schedule has no capacity to absorb a GCC High learning curve. **Key Responsibilities** ***Infrastructure Build*** * Provision Atom’s GCC High Operations Tenant through an AOS\-G authorized partner and build the parallel Azure Commercial Operations Tenant as isolated sovereign tracks * Establish Entra ID baseline across both tenants: admin account structure, security group naming conventions, and identity governance configuration * Deploy Azure Virtual Desktop host pool in Azure Government for SOC analyst and vCISO secure access * Configure Microsoft Lighthouse delegation framework across both tracks to support multi\-client MSSP management * Implement FIDO2/phish\-resistant MFA and Conditional Access policies across all administrative accounts on both tenants ***Identity and Access Governance*** * Configure Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for all privileged roles across both tenants * Enroll all analyst devices, vCISO devices, and AVD session hosts into GCC High and Commercial Intune respectively * Document the separate Entra identity model (distinct UPNs per track) as a formal access control artifact ***Security Toolchain Deployment*** * Stand up Microsoft Sentinel MSSP workspaces on both tracks with baseline analytics rules, alert routing, and cross\-workspace KQL queries * Apply Defender XDR P2 baseline policy across the GCC High tenant * Deploy CrowdStrike Gov endpoint agents to CMMC client environments; deploy CrowdStrike Commercial Falcon for non\-CMMC clients * Activate Azure Arc and Intune management on Atom operations devices * Verify track separation end\-to\-end and reflect findings in finalized network diagrams ***Legacy Tool Migration*** * Build SharePoint GCC High site structure to receive runbooks, SOPs, and client documentation migrated from legacy documentation platforms * Configure Azure DevOps Boards (GCC High) as the ticketing and work management replacement * Provision Azure Key Vault and execute controlled credential migration with documented access policy review * Update Atom’s System Security Plan (SSP) to remove transitional tool entries upon retirement confirmation ***Go\-Live and Growth*** * Support compliance documentation sprints — provide infrastructure evidence artifacts for SSP completion * Conduct end\-to\-end Lighthouse delegation testing for both anchor clients prior to go\-live * Complete final infrastructure verification pass against the go\-live readiness checklist * Support onboarding of client accounts to the Atom service omputer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment. * Ability to work on occasion to respond to security incidents outside normal business hours. * Primarily an office environment; occasional travel to client sites may be required. * Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. * Valid driver’s license and reliable form of transportation. **BENEFITS** **GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week) and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in health benefits through BlueCross BlueShield of Illinois (BCBSIL). Health options include a choice of 2 PPO plans, a High Deductible Health plan and an HMO. In addition, Dental benefits are available as well as a Vision PPO plan utilizing the EyeMed network. Atom Cyber Security also offers voluntary worksite benefits including critical illness and accident coverage, short\-term disability insurance, supplemental life and pet insurance. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LIFE/AD\&D INSURANCE:** After a 30\-day waiting period, Atom Cyber Security provides a flat $25,000 Life Insurance benefit, administered by Mutual of Omaha, to all full\-time employees (who work at least 30 hours per week). Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) benefit payments are determined based on the type of loss incurred and are payable up to the full Life Insurance benefit amount. Life and AD\&D Insurance coverage amounts are reduced at ages 65, 70 and 75\. **EMPLOYER PROVIDED LTD:** Long\-Term Disability (LTD) insurance is an employer\-provided benefit and provides protection from loss of income in the event that an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or accident for a long period of time. The elimination period is 90\-days, and the maximum benefit is 60% of covered payroll up to $6000/month. This benefit is paid entirely by Atom Cyber Security and has no cost to the employee. **EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM:** All employees may utilize the Disability Resource Services through Mutual of Omaha to assist themselves and their immediate family with convenient resources to help address emotional, legal and financial issues. Telephonic counseling and web\-based services are available as well as a limited number of geographically accessible face\-to\-face sessions. **401K PLAN:** All employees are eligible after 120 days of service to contribute on either a pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) basis to the 401K plan, administered by Principal Financial Services. Proven offers an employer match equal to 100% of the first 3% of deferrals plus 50% of the next 2% of deferrals. **FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES:** Atom Cyber Security partners with Merrill Lynch to offer financial advisement to all employees. Merrill Lynch financial advisors are available to assist employees at no cost, with their 401k and retirement questions. **PERMISSIVE TIME OFF POLICY:** Atom Cyber Security provides a competitive paid time off policy for all full\-time regular employees after a 90\-day waiting period. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** ============================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI systems become increasingly capable, progress depends not only on better models, but on the quality of the data, environments, and feedback used to train them. We build the infrastructure that makes this possible. Our work spans clinical reasoning, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We combine deep domain expertise with software infrastructure to generate high\-quality training data, evaluate model behavior, and develop reinforcement learning environments for increasingly autonomous AI systems. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** to build the platform that powers the creation, curation, evaluation, and delivery of high\-quality data for frontier AI models. You'll work on a sophisticated platform that coordinates domain experts, AI models, automated evaluation systems, and complex data production workflows. Our platform enables scientists, physicians, and other experts to create and validate training data, develop evaluation tasks, annotate model outputs, and collaborate with AI\-assisted tools. Behind the scenes, it orchestrates multi\-stage workflows, manages large datasets, tracks quality, and transforms expert knowledge into structured, machine\-consumable outputs. This isn't a conventional annotation tool or CRUD application. We're building an intelligent data production system where human expertise, model\-generated content, programmatic validation, and automated feedback loops work together at scale. You'll have significant ownership across the product and infrastructure stack, working directly with the founding team, researchers, and domain experts to turn complex data creation processes into intuitive, reliable, and scalable software. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build the data creation platform:** Design and implement core product features that enable experts to create, annotate, review, validate, and refine complex training and evaluation datasets. * **Develop intelligent workflows:** Build flexible, multi\-stage pipelines combining human contributions, AI\-generated content, automated evaluation, and expert review. * **Build AI\-native interfaces:** Develop tools that enable experts to collaborate effectively with AI models, including AI\-assisted annotation, content generation, feedback, and validation. * **Engineer data infrastructure:** Build robust systems for dataset storage, versioning, lineage, transformations, quality control, and delivery. * **Develop task orchestration:** Implement assignment, routing, dependencies, review queues, quality gates, and workflow automation across distributed teams of experts. * **Build evaluation and quality systems:** Integrate model\-based judges, programmatic verifiers, consensus mechanisms, and quality metrics to ensure data reliability. * **Create exceptional product experiences:** Build fast, intuitive interfaces for complex scientific and healthcare workflows, balancing flexibility with simplicity. * **Integrate frontier AI models:** Develop infrastructure for model inference, structured generation, prompt execution, and automated feedback loops. * **Scale the platform:** Improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience as data volume, workflow complexity, and expert participation grow. * **Own systems end to end:** Drive technical decisions from product design and system architecture through implementation, deployment, and iteration. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Strong proficiency in **TypeScript and Python**, with experience building sophisticated, production\-grade applications. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js, and a strong understanding of frontend architecture and application state management. * Solid backend engineering experience, including APIs, relational databases, asynchronous processing, and distributed services. * Experience designing complex data models, workflow systems, and scalable application infrastructure. * Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, queues, background jobs, caching, and cloud infrastructure. * Ability to build thoughtful user experiences for technically complex products. * Strong product intuition and the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into elegant, maintainable solutions. * Demonstrated ability to independently architect, ship, and iterate on comple arly excited if you have** * Experience building data annotation, labeling, evaluation, or human\-in\-the\-loop platforms. * Experience with AI training data pipelines, dataset curation, synthetic data generation, or model evaluation. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, structured generation, tool calling, prompt management, and AI\-assisted workflows. * Experience building workflow orchestration systems, task queues, or configurable workflow engines. * Knowledge of data versioning, provenance, lineage, schema validation, and reproducibility. * Experience designing collaborative tools involving review, approvals, permissions, and complex state transitions. * Background in developer tools, internal platforms, scientific software, or other technically demanding products. * Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, or scientific datasets. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy difficult problems, move quickly, and take pride in creating exceptional software. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, understand users deeply, and are comfortable owning problems without a predefined playbook. * **Quantitative trading and high\-performance engineering:** Engineers accustomed to demanding technical environments, complex systems, and high standards for correctness and reliability. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who enjoy difficult technical and mathematical challenges. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong engineering skills with an interest in logic, reasoning, formal systems, and the foundations of intelligence. * **Makers and independent builders:** People who build ambitious side projects, open\-source software, robots, hardware, or unconventional tools simply because they love creating things. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments & Sandboxes
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** =========================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI moves beyond answering questions toward executing complex scientific workflows, models need more than training data. They need environments where they can interact with tools, make decisions, execute experiments, observe consequences, and learn from verifiable outcomes. We build those environments. Our work spans clinical systems, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We're developing both computational environments and environments connected to physical wet\-lab infrastructure, bridging AI agents with real scientific instruments, robotic systems, and experimental workflows. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** to build high\-fidelity environments where frontier AI agents learn to perform complex, real\-world tasks. You'll design and implement stateful, executable environments that allow agents to interact with software, APIs, scientific tools, and laboratory systems. These environments must be reproducible, verifiable, and scalable enough to support reinforcement learning and rigorous evaluation. This role is particularly exciting because your work won't be limited to simulated software. You'll work closely with our wet\-lab team to build the infrastructure connecting AI agents to physical experiments, laboratory automation, and real biological outcomes. You'll own systems end to end, from environment architecture and sandbox execution to tool interfaces, task verification, and rollout infrastructure. We're looking for someone who enjoys working at the boundary of software, AI, and the physical world — someone who would be equally excited about building a distributed execution engine and making a laboratory robot perform an experiment. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build RL environments:** Design and implement realistic, stateful environments that reproduce complex workflows across healthcare, biology, and scientific software. * **Develop secure sandboxes:** Build isolated, reproducible execution environments supporting agent\-generated code, tool calls, filesystem operations, and application interactions. * **Connect AI agents to the wet lab:** Work with scientists and automation engineers to integrate laboratory instruments, robotic liquid handlers, experimental protocols, and biological readouts into agent\-accessible workflows. * **Build agent\-facing tools:** Implement MCP servers, APIs, and interfaces that enable agents to interact with software applications, scientific instruments, and simulated systems. * **Engineer state management:** Develop deterministic initialization, snapshot/restore, state transitions, resets, and execution replay. * **Develop tasks and verifiers:** Translate real\-world workflows into executable tasks with clear success criteria, ground\-truth states, and programmatic verification. * **Scale environment execution:** Build orchestration infrastructure for high\-throughput parallel rollouts, supporting both simulated environments and physical experiments with appropriate execution controls. * **Work with Harbor:** Develop, integrate, and validate environments using Harbor\-compatible task structures, execution harnesses, and evaluation workflows. * **Improve environment fidelity:** Identify unrealistic shortcuts, hidden state inconsistencies, and verification gaps that could compromise training quality. * **Own the full lifecycle:** Take ambitious technical ideas from early prototypes through production\-grade infrastructure. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Excellent Python skills and strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, systems design, and software architecture. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Linux, containers, process isolation, or sandbox execution. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, state management, and reliability. * Experience designing complex APIs, backend systems, and integrations. * Ability to independently architect, build, debug, and ship sophisticated technical systems. **We'd be particularly excited if you have** * Hands\-on experience with **Harbor**, especially building custom RL environments, task definitions, verifiers, or evaluation infrastructure. * Experience with RL environments, AI agents, model evaluation, or agent training infrastructure. * Familiarity with MCP, Gymnasium, Ray, or similar agent and execution frameworks. * Experience with robotics, laboratory automation, hardware interfaces, or cyber\-physical systems. * Knowledge of deterministic simulation, sandbox orchestration, reproducible execution, and reward verification. * Experience with scientific computing, bioinformatics, or computational biology. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy unusually difficult problems and have a track record of pursuing ambitious ideas beyond what's expected of them. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, are comfortable with ambiguity, and naturally take ownership. * **Quantitative trading and low\-latency engineering:** Engineers from quantitative trading firms or similarly demanding environments who have developed exceptional problem\-solving skills, strong systems intuition, and a high bar for correctness. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who genuinely enjoy difficult technical and mathematical problems. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong technical reasoning with an interest in logic, epistemology, formal systems, and foundational questions about intelligence. * **Makers and tinkerers:** People who build robots, hardware, electronics, open\-source tools, or ambitious hobby projects simply because they find them interesting. These aren't requirements or substitutes for demonstrated engineering ability. They're examples of the curiosity, intellectual intensity, and builder mentality we value. We care much more about what you've built, how you think, and how quickly you learn than about credentials or conventional career paths. **What We're Offering** ----------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI and science:** Build infrastructure that enables advanced AI agents to interact with real scientific systems and tackle meaningful problems in biology and medicine. * **Bridge software and the physical world:** Work directly with wet\-lab infrastructure, laboratory robotics, and experimental workflows — not just simulations or datasets. * **Exceptional technical ownership:** Shape fundamental architectural decisions and own critical systems from concept to production. * **Hard, unsolved problems:** Tackle challenges involving secure execution, distributed systems, real\-world simulation, robotics, and reinforcement learning. * **Small, high\-caliber team:** Collaborate directly with founders, AI researchers, scientists, and engineers who care deeply about their craft. * **Freedom to build:** Work in an environment that encourages experimentation, rapid prototyping, intellectual independence, and unconventional approaches. * **Competitive compensation and meaningful equity:** Participate in the long\-term value you help create. * **Room to grow:** Help define the technical foundations and engineering culture of an ambitious company at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We're looking for people who don't just want to build software, but want to build systems that expand what intelligence can do in the real world. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software & Firmware Engineering Experts — AI Code Evaluation
jobs.description: Software \& Firmware Engineering Experts — AI Code Evaluation is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software \& Firmware Engineering Experts — AI Code Evaluation assignments. * Grade embedded systems solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software \& Firmware Engineering Experts — AI Code Evaluation work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Embedded systems **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- $100–$120 / hr **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

Research and evaluate emerging technologies for inclusion within Agency’s enterprise application environment. **Position Requirements** ------------------------- A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree is required. A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, GIS, Physics, or Engineering is preferred. A minimum of two (2\) years total credited experience.\* Two (2\) years of experience working in an Information Technology group or R\&D software lab are required. This position ensures maximum uptime, reliability, and performance of machinery to meet production and quality objectives. The Equipment Technician collaborates closely with manufacturing engineers, operators, and quality teams to support continuous improvement and safe, efficient operations. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **Equipment Maintenance \& Repair** * Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on manufacturing equipment, test stations, conveyors, and robotic systems. * Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system failures. * Maintain detailed maintenance logs, service records, and calibration documentation. * Identify root causes of equipment failures and recommend corrective actions. **Installation \& Setup** * Assist with equipment installation, relocation, and commissioning for new production lines. * Support integration of new automation, vision inspection, and test systems. * Calibrate equipment and ensure proper functionality before handoff to production. **Process Support** * Collaborate with engineers to improve equipment performance and reliability. * Support production line changes, tooling adjustments, and process optimizations. * Implement maintenance best practices to minimize unplanned downtime. **Safety \& Compliance** * Follow all OSHA, EHS, and company safety policies and procedures. * Ensure all tools, parts, and equipment are handled and stored properly. * Participate in equipment safety audits and corrective action implementation. ### **Qualifications** * **Education:** High School Diploma, Associate Degree (preferred) * **Experience:** Minimum of 3 years of experience in equipment maintenance, preferably in electronics manufacturing, assembly, or automated production environments. * **Technical Skills:** + Proficient in troubleshooting PLCs, sensors, motors, pneumatic and hydraulic systems. + Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics. + Experience with soldering, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and test instruments. + Familiarity with robotics, vision systems, and automated test equipment (ATE). * **Software Knowledge:** CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), Microsoft Office, and basic CAD or control software familiarity preferred. ### **Core Competencies** * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Attention to detail and accuracy in technical documentation. * Effective communication and teamwork in cross\-functional environments. * Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Adaptability in a fast\-paced manufacturing setting. ### **Working Conditions and Physical Demands** * Work is primarily performed in a **manufacturing and assembly environment** involving exposure to machinery, moving mechanical parts, electrical systems, and occasional high noise levels. * May require work in **cleanroom or ESD\-controlled areas** and adherence to static control procedures. * **Physical Requirements:** + Frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, crouching, and climbing ladders or platforms. + Regular lifting and carrying of objects up to **50 pounds**; occasional lifting of heavier components with mechanical assistance. + Manual dexterity and fine motor skills for handling tools, wiring, and delicate electronic parts. + Visual acuity to read schematics, detect equipment malfunctions, and inspect parts. + Ability to work in varying temperatures and occasionally confined spaces. * **Work Hours:** + May require **rotating shifts, weekend coverage, overtime, or on\-call availability** to support production uptime and critical repairs ### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * Equipment uptime and reliability metrics (MTBF / MTTR). * Preventive maintenance completion rate and schedule adherence. * Reduction in unplanned downtime or recurring failures. * Compliance with safety and EHS standards. Quality of maintenance documentation and improvement initiatives supported.

reconciliation. · Working experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and analytics platform. · Experience with Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform. · Qualifications** ---------------------------- · Hands\-on experience supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, semantic models, refresh schedules, subscriptions, access, and jobs.description: Resident Engineer, AI Security The Resident Engineer, AI Security serves as a hands\-on technical engineer embedded onsite with one of A10's largest financial services customers in Sunrise, Florida. You will sit directly with the customer's AI platform, model risk, and security engineering teams to operate and scale two critical disciplines: runtime AI firewall enforcement and adversarial model testing. On the runtime side, you will deploy and operate inline inspection of AI traffic — prompts, responses, retrieval context, tool/MCP calls, and agent\-to\-agent exchanges — managing policies that determine what gets blocked, redacted, rewritten, or logged. On the testing side, you will build and run adversarial evaluation workflows that probe models, RAG pipelines, and agents before and after they reach production. This role suits an intermediate\-level engineer who bridges backend systems development, cloud infrastructure, and practical AI security. **Responsibilities** **AI Firewall and Runtime Enforcement** * Deploy, configure, and maintain inline AI traffic inspection across inference paths (self\-hosted models, commercial APIs, RAG, and agents) * Manage proxy topologies, TLS termination/SSLi, streaming/SSE response handling, and proxy routing across modern network stacks using tools like Envoy, NGINX, or HAProxy * Implement and tune guardrail policies: prompt injection/jailbreak detection, PII/PCI/MNPI data leakage, grounding controls, and token rate limiting * Enforce authorization, tool\-use policies, and identity attribution across REST and gRPC endpoints to ensure every agentic action maps to a verified principal Monitor baseline false positive/negative rates, shadow\-test policy updates, and manage inspection latency to meet production SLA budgets * **Adversarial Model Testing and Red Teaming** * Execute automated red team campaigns against models, vector databases (e.g., PostgreSQL with pgvector), and RAG pipelines covering injection, data extraction, poisoning, and cost\-exhaustion risks * Maintain versioned test suites and automated evaluation harnesses using Python and Go * Integrate security testing gates directly into the customer’s MLOps, CI/CD, and dev pipelines Produce structured finding reports with clear reproduction steps, severity assessments, and concrete remediation steps (policy changes, system prompt updates, or infrastructure controls) * **Customer Collaboration \& Product Feedback** * Collaborate daily with the customer's platform architects, model risk teams, and security leads on control selection and threat modeling * Map control coverage to common industry frameworks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF) Feed operational feedback, detection gaps, and bug reports back to A10 Product and Engineering teams to continuously improve the core product * **Required Qualifications** * **Experience:** 5–7 years of professional experience in software engineering, security engineering, cloud platform engineering, and technical solution delivery * **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in **Python** and **Go** for building production\-grade integrations, microservices, micro\-benchmarks, and test automation harnesses * **Data \& Middleware:** Strong working knowledge of **PostgreSQL** (schema design, query optimization, indexing) and API architectures using **REST** and **gRPC** * **Cloud \& DevOps:** Hands\-on experience deploying and managing workloads in at least one major cloud provider ( **AWS, GCP, or Azure** ), alongside containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines * **Networking \& Traffic Management:** Solid understanding of core networking concepts, L4/L7 traffic management, reverse proxies (e.g., Envoy, NGINX, HAProxy), TLS decryption/inspection, and networking diagnostics (e.g., tcpdump, wireshark, curl, dig) * **AI \& Security Foundations:** Practical understanding of LLM application stacks (RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool\-calling) and basic exposure to AI/LLM security risks (prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage) * **Delivery:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of implementing technical solutions directly within enterprise environments * **Location:** Ability to work onsite in Sunrise, FL on a regular, customer\-embedded schedule * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working within financial services or highly regulated environments (understanding of PCI DSS, GLBA, SOX, or model risk frameworks like SR 11\-7\) * Prior experience in customer\-embedded engineering, professional services, or technical field roles at an enterprise security software company * Exposure to vector extensions in relational databases (e.g., pgvector in PostgreSQL) or specialized vector stores * Hands\-on experience with LLM guardrail frameworks, AI gateways, or red\-teaming toolkits (e.g., Garak, PyRIT) * Familiarity with A10 product suites, web application firewalls (WAAP), or ADC/SSLi technologies Industry certifications such as AWS/GCP/Azure Security or Developer Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or security certifications (e.g., Security\+, OSCP)" * ### **A10 Networks is an equal opportunity employer and a jobs.description: **At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference** Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for equity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better \- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose. ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable environment in which every team member has an opportunity to grow. We want our team members to have the well\-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here. We are seeking a **Data Scientist II** to help us fulfill that mission. ACT is seeking a Data Scientist II to help build a new pathway navigation experience that helps high school students explore, plan, and take confident next steps toward college and career. This role will design, test, and validate the data models that power personalized college, career, and pathway recommendations. jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. You'll be a senior individual contributor writing firmware and software for taking new boards from first power\-on to a stable, validated platform. You'll set the technical direction for how we validate, debug, and sign off silicon\-to\-solution across hardware and software. **THE PERSON:** You understand how firmware, silicon, and hardware interact, and you can follow a failure across all three. You bring deep hands\-on hardware bring\-up and validation experience, strong analytical instincts, and the judgment to know what production readiness looks like for a platform. You work well with global teams, communicate clearly, and you go looking for the hard, ambiguous problems rather than around them. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** System\-Level Validation: Define and drive the silicon\-to\-solution validation strategy — plans, coverage, regression, and signoffs. Bring up baremetal and embedded Linux to exercise the full system. Write firmware and low\-level system software for on\-chip ARM (APU/RPU) or RISC\-V cores. Build and customize embedded Linux images using the Yocto\-based Embedded Design Flow (BSP configuration, device trees, kernel/rootfs tuning, custom recipes and layers). * Board Bring\-Up \& Validation: Own new board bring\-up from first power\-on through a stable platform. Build the scripts, baremetal code, and debug flows the boards team needs to complete bring\-up and validation. * Test Development \& Automation: Develop validation tests and applications in baremetal and Linux environments, and automate execution and regression to scale coverage. * Debug: Debug complex issues that span silicon, firmware, drivers, and the operating system. * Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Signoff: Partner with architecture, design, verification, software, product engineering, and board teams. Drive production readiness, issue tracking, risk assessment, and validation signoff. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Hands on embedded systems and hardware validation experience. * Proven board bring\-up and validation experience — taking a new board from power\-on through boot and interface bring\-up, and debugging clocking, reset, power, and hardware issues on the bench. * Strong C/C\+\+ for bare\-metal and Linux\-based embedded systems on ARM or RISC\-V cores; Linux kernel\-mode driver knowledge is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience with AMD/Xilinx embedded Linux flows: building and customizing images with the Yocto\-based Embedded Design Flow (BSPs, device trees, custom recipes/layers). * Experience validating interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, plus common peripherals like SPI, I²C, UART, and CAN. * Working knowledge of AMD/Xilinx Vitis and EDF environments. * Comfortable automating in Python, Tcl, Shell, and Makefiles, with Git and structured CI/regression workflows. * Strong ownership and communication, with a track record of technical leadership and mentoring. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Application Engineer-Memory Subsystems
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE** ------------ Join our team to drive customer success on the memory subsystem across our silicon portfolio, covering DDR and LPDDR across generations and the memory controller, Network\-on\-Chip and physical interface behind them. You will be a technical point of contact for escalated memory cases, from early design\-in and bring\-up through production support. You are the person strategic customers escalate to when memory does not behave the way the specification says it should. You will root\-cause those failures on real systems, drive the fix through the teams that own it, and review next\-generation memory architecture and design to catch defects before they reach silicon. You will also own the memory documentation customers design against. The scope runs from JEDEC device behavior and PCB routing, through controller architecture and RAS features, to the product and roadmap decisions your findings should drive.**THE PERSON** -------------- You have a passion for memory technology, system architecture, and hardware debug at the level where silicon, firmware, board and DRAM device all interact. You are a thorough memory expert who knows what the specification says, what the silicon actually does, and where the two diverge. You are a team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience collaborating with engineers located in different sites and timezones, and you can hold a technical conversation directly with a customer. You are effective across organizations you do not manage, and you are drawn to problems that arrive without a clear owner or a clear root cause. We place a high value on technical writing. You produce documentation a customer can design against with confidence, and you can present a complex technical finding clearly to both engineering and customer audiences.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ **Customer Support and Debug:** Own escalated customer support issues for memory, from early design\-in and bring\-up through production support. Partner with key customers to root\-cause system memory failures such as intermittent errors, calibration and training failures, and margin and boot issues. Attribute each correctly across DRAM, board, controller IP, calibration firmware and silicon, and drive the fix to closure.**Memory Subsystem and Interconnect Expertise:** Be the authority on DDR and LPDDR, covering JEDEC standards, device behavior, module topologies, ranks, widths and supported data rates. Know how traffic reaches the controller across the Network\-on\-Chip, including QoS, arbitration, and bandwidth and latency budgeting.**Customer Documentation and Communication:** Author the customer\-facing memory documentation, including product guides, user guides, datasheets, answer records, tutorials and layout guidance, and publish resolutions internally and externally.**Architecture Review and RAS Validation:** Review memory and NoC architecture and design specifications for next\-generation silicon, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and design bugs, and proposing fixes. Evaluate and validate its memory RAS features.**Signal and Power Integrity:** Perform DRAM SI/PI and timing measurements. Apply PCB layout and routing knowledge for DDR and LPDDR to assess customer designs and define the layout guidance we publish. Support IBIS/IBIS\-AMI models and channel simulation.**Memory Health Tooling and Experiments:** Create experiments and tooling that catch memory health issues before they are reported. Write targeted memory tests in C to stress and characterize specific failure modes on real hardware.**Product Influence and Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Translate system\-level challenges into product and roadmap decisions on supported configurations, data rates, feature scope and documentation accuracy. Drive teams across IP, firmware, tools, signal integrity, validation and quality without direct authority, for feature enablement, optimization and characterization.**Apply AI to Engineering Workflows:** Use AI/LLM/ML tools to surface design gaps, summarize and correlate large test and log datasets, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation.**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** ------------------------ * Extensive hands\-on experience with memory subsystems in an applications, architecture, design, or validation role, built across multiple DRAM generations and product cycles. * Expertise across DDR and LPDDR generations (DDR4/DDR5, LPDDR4/4X/5/5X/6\), with fluency in the relevant JEDEC specifications and in module variants (UDIMM, SODIMM, RDIMM, LRDIMM, CUDIMM). HBM experience is a plus. * Excellent technical writing, with a track record of authoring and publishing customer\-facing documentation that an external audience designs against: product guides, user guides, datasheets, answer records and tutorials. * Deep knowledge of DRAM, memory controller and PHY architecture: command scheduling and arbitration, address mapping and decode, calibration and training, DQS gating and delay\-line behavior, termination and drive strength, voltage and temperature tracking, and page policy, with experience evaluating and validating RAS features. * Working knowledge of on\-chip interconnect architecture, including Network\-on\-Chip, and of bandwidth and latency budgeting. * Proven root cause of system\-level memory failures, attributing each correctly across the DRAM device, board, controller IP, firmware, tools and silicon, including reading calibration and training firmware closely enough to trace a failure to the step that produced it. Hands\-on lab debug with oscilloscopes, signal generators, BERTs, logic and protocol analyzers, and register\-level debug over JTAG. * Hands\-on DRAM SI/PI and timing analysis (measurement on real hardware, eye and margin analysis, and channel simulation with IBIS and IBIS\-AMI models) together with a practical understanding of PCB layout and routing for DDR/LPDDR. Platform\-level signal and power integrity is a plus. * Experience working directly with strategic customers in technical or architecture\-facing roles, translating system\-level challenges into product or roadmap decisions, and influencing multi\-functional teams without direct authority, with a track record of mentoring and running technical reviews. * **Demonstrated use of AI in engineering workflows**, applying AI/LLM/ML tools to identify design gaps, summarize collected data for distribution and analysis, and drive productivity in debug, automation and documentation. * Strong C for writing targeted memory test applications, and able to read architecture specifications, design documentation and SystemVerilog/Verilog RTL closely enough to identify implementation bugs. **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.****\#LI\-RL1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services.
