jobs.title: Senior AI Inference Engineer - Model Optimization & Deployment
jobs.description: The Perception team is pioneering the development of a multi\-modality foundation model to drive the next generation of autonomous system intelligence. As a Model Optimization \& Deployment Engineer, you will focus on bringing highly efficient, production\-ready large\-scale models to our on\-vehicle stack. We are looking for experts with hands\-on experience in compressing, accelerating, and deploying complex models (LLMs, VLMs, or FMs) for power\- and thermal\-constrained vehicle SOCs. You will optimize the ML models, write custom CUDA kernels, and build highly concurrent inference code to ensure real\-time, deterministic execution on edge devices. ### **In this role, you will:** * Optimize large\-scale models (Multi\-Modal Sensor Fusion models, LLMs, VLMs) using advanced quantization (PTQ, QAT), pruning, mixed\-precision inference frameworks, and parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA). * Architect and implement model conversion and compilation pipelines using TensorRT for edge deployment. * Perform rigorous parity checking, accuracy recovery, and latency benchmarking between PyTorch frameworks and compiled edge binaries. * Develop and optimize custom ML OPs and TensorRT Plugins with efficient CUDA kernels to minimize latency and maximize memory bandwidth on AI accelerators. * Write production\-level, low latency, and memory\-safe C\+\+ and CUDA code for real\-time inference on vehicle systems. ### **Qualifications:** * Deep expertise in model quantization (PTQ, QAT) and mixed\-precision inference frameworks (INT8, FP8, FP4, BF16/FP16\). * Proven experience optimizing large\-scale models (Multi\-Modal Sensor Fusion models, LLMs, VLMs/VLAs) utilizing Efficient Attention mechanisms (e.g., FlashAttention, Linear Attention), KV\-cache optimization (e.g., PagedAttention) and Speculative Decoding. * Extensive experience with model conversion/compilation pipelines (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, torch.compile) and performing rigorous latency benchmark and model quality parity valuation. * Proficiency in low\-level programming for AI accelerators, specifically developing and optimizing custom ML OPs and TensorRT Plugins with efficient CUDA kernel implementations. * Production\-level C\+\+ (14/17/20\) and Python programming skills, with experience developing concurrent, memory\-safe, real\-time inference code for edge devices. ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Familiarity with SOTA autonomous driving perception algorithms (temporal 3D object detection, BEV, 3D Occupancy Networks) and multi\-modal sensor processing (Vision, LiDAR, Radar). * Experience with distributed training pipelines and model/tensor parallelism (PyTorch Distributed, Ray, DeepSpeed, Megatron\-LM) and runtime efficiency optimization for GPU clusters. * Experience with end\-to\-end autonomous driving paradigms (VLM/VLA models, Foundation models) and edge deployment technologies (e.g., TensorRT\-LLM). **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Suno is scaling incredibly fast and our job is to unlock growth for operations areas like music ops, support, legal, finance, and beyond with workflows, tooling, and intelligent agents. **What You'll Do** * Build agents, workflows, and custom tools that let non\-engineering teams handle more without adding headcount * Evaluate and integrate third\-party tools, making the call on what to buy and what to build * Contribute to and empower stakeholders on our self\-service app deployment platform * Design and implement new patterns for internal APIs, auth and MCP building and extending beyond our Django monolith. * Integrate and scale customer experience systems built around third parties like Zendesk. * Partner with customer experience, legal, finance, people, and content ops to source new challenges **What You'll Need** Must\-Haves * You bring 5–7\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience * You have a proven track record of building, maintaining, and supporting internal tooling or systems that streamline engineering or business operations * You’re eager to learn and share agentic coding best practices and tools * You thrive in an early\-stage, 0 1 environment where the problem space is still being defined Nice\-to\-Haves * You’ve worked with agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) and eval or observability tooling (e.g. LangSmith, Braintrust) * You’re familiar with support tooling, CRM systems, or workflow automation platforms Not sure you meet every point above? Please apply anyway! If you're excited about this work and think you could make an impact here, we'd love to hear from you. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.title: Product Operations Lead
jobs.description: **OUR MISSION** --------------- We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high\-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond. Today, Thyme Care is a market\-leading value\-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high\-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers. As a tech\-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. That only happens when the people using our tools understand them, trust them, and have a clear path to get help when something isn't working. Strong product operations is how we close the gap between what we build and how it's used every day. Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ We're hiring a Product Operations Lead to make sure the software we build works well for the people who use it, from the day a feature ships and every day after. Thyme Care runs on three software platforms. The largest, Thyme Box, is the care management platform where our nurses, social workers, care partners, nurse practitioners, and medical directors spend their day. You'll connect our product and engineering teams with the care team: you'll know how our products work in practice, spot problems early, and make sure changes land smoothly. The work is broad. It covers first\-line triage and user support, rollout planning, training and documentation, usage monitoring, and the operating rhythm of the product organization. Many of these processes exist informally today, and you'll have room to formalize and improve them. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineering, quality engineering, data science, service design, our training team, and Care Delivery and Enrollment operations. Additionally, you will: * **Become the expert on how our products work:** learn all three of our platforms and the key data assets behind them in depth, give introductory demos to new team members across tech and the broader company, and be a go\-to resource when someone needs to understand how something works * **Serve as first\-line triage for Thyme Box issues:** partner with Quality Engineering on bug triage, field reports from the care team, ask the clarifying questions that separate "the product works differently than I expected" from "something is broken," and hand off well\-documented issues for technical investigation * **Run product rollouts:** partner with PMs and engineering to plan and project manage feature pilots and rollouts with Care Delivery and Enrollment operations, provide first\-line support to end users as changes go live, and own release notes and cross\-functional communications and training materials for upcoming releases * **Support quality before launch:** help QA new features across engineering and service design pods, and set up in\-product walkthroughs and tooltips for new functionality * **Keep training and documentation accurate:** own the accuracy of Thyme Box training documentation and reference materials; partner with our training team on new hire onboarding and refresher materials for the care team; and review other training materials and process changes for how they interact with Thyme Box, recommending ways to streamline those processes in the tool * **Monitor usage and listen to users:** use tools and data analysis to spot unusual Thyme Box usage patterns and flag them to the right teams, and run regular user satisfaction surveys, turning results into clear findings that product teams can act on * **Keep product teams close to the care team:** coordinate regular shadowing sessions so product, engineering, and data science see their users' work firsthand, and create documents, videos, and other materials that explain to the care team how our tech teams work and how they can contribute * **Run the product org's operating rhythm:** maintain a current product roadmap deck across all pods by gathering inputs from each PM, and own the product process calendar, including quarterly roadmap planning, vendor renewals, tech debt days, hackathons, and other recurring milestones * **Use AI to work more efficiently:** apply AI tools to drafting documentation, analyzing survey and usage data, and building training materials **WHAT YOU'VE DONE** --- oducible bug reports * Track record of planning and running software rollouts, including training, communications, and user support through launch * Experience creating training materials, documentation, or user guides that people actually use and that drive successful feature adoption * Comfort working with data: you can use monitoring or analytics tools, pull together usage data, and explain what you're seeing to non\-technical audiences * Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to keep many recurring processes and deadlines on track at once * Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between technical and non\-technical audiences in both directions * Practical experience using AI tools in your day\-to\-day work, and curiosity about where they can help * Experience operating in fast\-moving environments where processes weren't fully defined yet Nice to haves: * Experience with Datadog or similar monitoring and product analytics tools * Experience configuring in\-app guidance (walkthroughs, tooltips) or other no\-code product tooling * Experience with QA or software testing **WHAT LEADS TO SUCCESS** ------------------------- **Operator empathy.** You understand that a nurse mid\-call with a member can't wait for a workaround. You take care team feedback seriously, explain things patiently, and earn trust by following through on what you hear. **Curiosity and investigative instinct.** When something seems off, you ask the next question. You can tell the difference between user confusion and a real defect, and you gather the details that let engineers move quickly. **Organized and reliable.** You keep a lot of moving parts on track: release notes, calendars, roadmap decks, surveys, training updates. Things don't slip because a detail fell through the cracks, and people trust that if you own it, it gets done. **Clear communication.** You write release notes, training materials, and summaries that are short, accurate, and easy to act on. You adjust your message for a care team audience, an engineering audience, or leadership. **Cross\-functional connector.** You build relationships across product, engineering, operations, and training. When an issue touches several teams, you know who to bring in and how to keep everyone aligned. **Continuous improvement.** You notice friction in processes like onboarding, rollouts, and triage, and you fix it rather than work around it. You treat documentation and process as things that need ongoing upkeep, not one\-time projects. **Practical about AI.** You use AI tools to work faster and produce better materials, and you know where you need to check the output before it goes to users. **OUR VALUES** -------------- At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we choose (or don't choose). Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $171,000\-$190,000\. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. We're here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal\-opportunity employer. *Be cautious of* ***recruitment fraud****, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.*

jobs.title: Social Media Strategist
jobs.description: Do you watch a TikTok twice, once to laugh and once to reverse\-engineer why it worked? Is your saves folder deeper than *Infinite Jest* is long? Fan\-TASTIC. \~Pourri (formerly Poo\~Pourri) is hunting an experienced **Social Media Strategist** with an elevated sense of humor, a creatively strategic mind, and real taste. The twist: you own two sets of channels, ours and our founder's, and you run them as one strategy. **About Us** In 2007, Suzy Bátiz created Poo\~Pourri, a natural, effective solution to a universal problem: sh\*t happens... and it stinks. Since then, Poo\~Pourri has grown into \~Pourri, reflecting a broader vision and expanding portfolio of products designed to help people live more freely and confidently. We're a team of fast\-paced rule\-breakers on a mission to find new paths to personal freedom. Our brand redefines how the world thinks and talks about taboos. In a world full of rules, playing it safe, and "that can't be done," \~Pourri doesn't subscribe to that crap. We dream differently. Want to come play with us? **About the role** We are looking for a Social Media Strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, engage, follow, share, and come back for more. This role will own the organic social strategy across both \~Pourri's brand channels and our founder's channels, developing a connected strategy that builds awareness, grows our audiences, increases engagement, and turns social into a meaningful driver for the business. We're looking for someone who doesn't just consume social media. You study it. You understand why something worked, what made someone engage, how platforms and audiences behave differently, and how to turn those insights into a repeatable growth strategy. You'll determine what we should be doing, where we should be doing it, why it matters, and how we'll measure whether it's working. This is a strategy\-first position, but it isn't strategy from the sidelines. We're a small, entrepreneurial team, so you'll stay close to the work, collaborate directly with our content and creative partners, and be willing to jump in when needed. **What you'll own (aka the** **sh****\*t you'll run with)** **Social Strategy \& Growth** * Develop and own the organic social strategy across \~Pourri and our founder's social channels. * Build strategies specifically designed to increase followers, engagement, reach, and brand awareness. * Determine the role of each platform, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube/YouTube Shorts, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and emerging channels. * Determine what content belongs where, what should cross over between brand and founder channels, and why. * Develop content pillars, recurring formats, series, and channel strategies that can scale. * Establish the appropriate posting cadence and broader content rhythm based on audience behavior and platform performance. * Identify opportunities to build greater connection between \~Pourri's brand ecosystem and our founder\-led content. **Insights, Analytics \& Optimization** * Establish social KPIs and reporting that clearly show what's working, what's not, and what we're doing next. * Analyze follower growth, engagement, reach, audience behavior, content performance, and emerging patterns. * Develop an ongoing organic testing strategy across hooks, formats, captions, creative approaches, pacing, timing, topics, and content styles. * Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for the creative and content teams. * Understand why high\-performing content works and use those learnings to inform future organic and paid content. * Identify consumer cohorts and audience segments from a social perspective and recommend strategies for reaching and engaging them. * Monitor competitive brands, creators, founders, cultural conversations, and emerging social behaviors to identify opportunities we can act on. **Platform Expertise \& Innovation** * Stay immersed in how social platforms are evolving, including algorithm changes, new features, emerging formats, and changing audience behavior. * Maintain relationships and stay in lockstep with platform and account representatives, including partners such as Meta. * Continually bring new ideas, opportunities, trends, tools, and platform learnings to the team. * Recognize the difference between a trend we should jump on and one we should leave alone. * Help \~Pourri move quickly when the internet presents an opportunity that authentically fits our brand. **Brand \+ Founder Strategy** * Develop a connected social ecosystem for both \~Pourri and our founder while maintaining their distinct voices, audiences, and objectives. * Understand how a founder\-led social presence can amplify the brand without simply duplicating brand content. * Help establish the voice, positioning, content pillars, and growth strategy for each channel. * Identify opportunities for founder content, podcast/episodic programming, brand content, and cultural moments to work togeth , agencies, creators, and outside partners. * Develop briefs and provide direction on the hooks, angles, formats, and platform variations needed to bring the strategy to life. * Partner with the content team on real\-time opportunities and adjust strategy based on what's happening online. * Identify high\-performing organic content that should move into paid testing and provide context around why it worked. * Provide strategic guidance for micro\-influencer and creator content, including briefs and performance feedback. **QUALIFICATIONS \+ EXPERIENCE (What we're looking for)** * 4–6 years of experience in social media strategy, organic social, content strategy, or a closely related field. * Proven experience developing social strategies that resulted in measurable follower growth, engagement, reach, or brand awareness. * Experience working with a consumer\-facing brand. * Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube/YouTube Shorts, with working knowledge of additional platforms such as Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and emerging channels. * Strong understanding of organic social analytics, KPIs, audience insights, platform performance, and experimentation. * Ability to show specific examples of strategies you've personally developed, what you changed, and the results those changes produced. * Strong understanding of short\-form content, social storytelling, hooks, trends, platform\-native creative, and what drives engagement. * Ability to balance creative instinct with data and use both to make decisions. * Strong writing, communication, and presentation skills. * Comfortable providing creative direction and working directly with people responsible for filming, editing, design, and content production. * Highly curious and naturally plugged into what's happening across social, culture, creators, consumer brands, and emerging platforms. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change quickly. * Willing to get into the weeds when needed. You're a strategist, but you're not above the work. * Available for in\-person collaboration, shoots, and events as needed. **Bonus points if you have... (That extra** **somethin****')** * Experience developing social strategy for a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or public figure. * Experience working within a founder\-led, entrepreneurial, or high\-growth consumer company. * Experience balancing a corporate/consumer brand voice with a founder's personal voice. * Social strategy experience for a podcast, episodic show, or other recurring programming. * Experience working directly with platform representatives from Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or other major social platforms. * Social listening experience. * Experience working with creators and micro\-influencers. * Experience translating organic social performance into paid social testing and creative recommendations. * Familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or Sprinklr and project management platforms such as Asana. * Enough knowledge of content production and editing workflows to give strong creative direction without needing to be the team's full\-time editor. **How You'll Know You're Winning** You're helping us answer, with data and creative conviction: * Are more people discovering us? * Are they choosing to follow us? * Are they engaging with us? * Do they keep coming back? * Do we understand why our best content is working? * Are we learning fast enough to make the next piece better? Most importantly, you're building a social strategy that turns those answers into action. **Benefits (The good stuff)** * Creative, energetic environment (with award\-winning products) * Hybrid work setup (remote plus in\-office and on\-set days) * Medical and dental benefits * Matching 401(k) * Massage chair and relaxation room *(when in\-office)* * Bottomless lattes *(also when in\-office, we're not shipping espresso... yet)* * Casual work environment, flush yeah * Endless poop and odor jokes (obviously)
